scripts.title: BHRM5 OPERATOR TOOL 2.1 Silent aim
scripts.features:
features
- Wall ESP — every hostile gets a vis-box on the head plus a live distance tag. Boxes update in real time: green means a clear bullet path, red means cover between you and him. Round-robin visibility pass, no target starvation, no fps hit.
- Silent Aim — FOV 140 lock that never snaps your camera. Refreshes at 33Hz against live target positions so moving NPCs are tracked in real time. Sticky target logic stops crosshair flicker. Head / Root aim switchable in the UI.
- Aggressive Wallbang — spawns the round 0.5m from his skull and skips all cover, regardless of wall thickness. Works seamstessly with Silent Aim; spread cone at that distance is ~0, so every shot lands.
- No Recoil + No Spread — recoil killed at the source (impulse null), spread zeroed per-shot with instant restore. No weapons jam, no camera freeze, reload stays functional.
- Fullbright — kills shadows and fog, near-daylight visibility.
- Smart target priority — a visible target always beats a walled one; walled targets only get engaged when wallbang is on. Other NPCs' bodies never count as walls.
- Self-protection — auto-detects your own third-person body and never locks it. Crosshair eats enemies, not your own skull.
- Live HUD — active-feature pill, target count, FPS counter.
- UI — click-drag anywhere, minimize, INSERT to toggle visibility, one-tap UNLOAD restores everything clean.
what's new in v2.3
- rebuilt spread handling — the old gun-jam on fire is gone
- recoil now killed via impulse null only — no camera freeze, no stuck reloads
- better vis-aim sync — ESP color now matches exactly what aim will lock
- faster, lighter core; rapid-fire and big-mag removed for stability
usage
load with your executor in PVE mode. paste, pick a mode, toggle features. INSERT hides the panel.
PVP tease (save for the next update)
PVP build is in active development — real-player targeting on the same core. follow for release when it drops.

scripts.title: Humanoid HUB aimbot esp
scripts.features:
Dropping the V8.2 update for Humanoid Hub. I built this from scratch to be completely universal, so it should work on 99% of FPS and combat games on Roblox.

My main focus for this version was completely killing those annoying FPS drops and making sure the aimbot actually sticks to the head without spazzing out or shaking. It’s highly optimized.

Features:

Sticky Aimbot (RMB): Right-click to lock on. I added a custom deadzone and velocity prediction (0.045). It predicts where they are going, locks on smoothly, and doesn't shake when it reaches the head. Wallbang is supported.

Dynamic ESP: Boxes, Skeletons, Health bars, and Distance. The ESP is color-coded using raycasts: Red = behind wall, Green = visible, Cyan = currently locked target.

Team Check: Universal team check is enabled for both ESP and Aimbot so you don't snap to your own teammates.

Zero Lag Scanner: I removed the constant GetDescendants spam. It only scans when a new character actually spawns in, so your FPS stays maxed out.

Lite-Fullbright: Removes shadows and fog without deep-frying your screen into pure white.

Modal Cursor Fix: If you play games that force mouse-lock (like Frontlines, Arsenal, etc.), my custom UI bypasses it so you can actually click the menu buttons without your mouse getting stuck.

local function ensureHighlight(model)
	if model:IsA("Model") and model.Name == "Male" then
		local highlight = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")
		
		if not highlight then
			-- Create new Highlight
			highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "AutoHighlight"
			highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) -- yellow (change if you want)
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			highlight.Parent = model
		end
	end
end

for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	ensureHighlight(obj)
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
	ensureHighlight(obj)
end)

workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(obj)
	if obj:IsA("Highlight") and obj.Parent and obj.Parent.Name == "Male" then
		task.wait() -- wait a frame so removal completes
		if obj.Parent then
			ensureHighlight(obj.Parent)
		end
	end
end)
